text: These are the raw shares of members. A calibration fitted on the October hindcasts, 1993–2016 (a shift and scale of every member's peak, each year left out in turn) did not beat them: its ranked probability skill against them is +0.03 (95% interval −0.62 to +0.44, p = 0.46) on the ONI and +0.12 (−0.43 to +0.51, p = 0.33) on RONI, not significant. Against climatology the raw odds score +0.82 (95% interval +0.67 to +0.91) on the ONI and +0.76 (+0.67 to +0.82) on RONI. The highest peak in those years was +2.6 °C on the ONI and +2.3 on RONI, so the odds of higher levels are untested.
method: For October starts (24 hindcast years, 1993–2016; ECMWF SEAS5, UKMO GloSea6, Météo-France 9, NCEP CFSv2, ECCC CanSIPSv3), the skill of the calibrated odds against the raw ones, out of sample, is +0.03 (95% interval −0.62 to +0.44, p = 0.46) on the ONI and +0.12 (−0.43 to +0.51, p = 0.33) on RONI; the raw odds score +0.82 (95% interval +0.67 to +0.91) on the ONI and +0.76 (+0.67 to +0.82) on RONI against climatology. How often the raw odds came true, pooled over the five levels and 24 years (forecasts in brackets): ONI odds under 5%, 0% (88); 5–35%, 10% (10); 35–65%, 0% (3); 65–95%, 71% (7); 95% or more, 100% (12); RONI odds under 5%, 0% (85); 5–35%, 8% (13); 35–65%, 33% (3); 65–95%, 57% (7); 95% or more, 100% (12). Start months tested so far: April, May, June, July, August, September, October; the calibration passed in none of them.
